newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki sags in vacant trade, seen slack.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki sags in vacant trade, seen slack.

text.p: Shares sagged in thin trade on Tuesday after the Dow industrials managed only minor gains overnight and with Nokia matching its lower Wall Street close.
With the FOX index down about 0.32 percent at midday, brokers said the market was likely to remain stuck in negative ground.
"The main thing on the horizon is Nokia's half-year report next Monday, and we won't be doing much until then," one broker said, predicting shares would end mildly lower for the day.
Nokia traded down 0.20 markka at 448.00, but off an early low of 447.10, in slim 20 million markka volume.
Merita shed 0.60 markka to 23.20, drifting lower in the absence of recent heavy buying pressure, brokers said.
Raisio went against the soft trend, rising 9.00 markka to 605.00, in fair nine million markka volume on the otherwise quiet bourse.
Amer was suspended at its own request, pending word from the company later in the day on whether it would redeem vote-heavy K shares sold at end-June to British investor Jonathan Bryan Guinness.
